newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - New York Times front page - Dec 26.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - New York Times front page - Dec 26.

text.p: The New York Times reported the following stories on its front page Thursday:
- The American mediator for the Middle East said he expected the Israelis and Palestinians to seal an agreement on the West Bank city of Hebron, probably as early as next week.
- This year the candidates for President and Congress and their advocates raised an estimates $2 billion on their campaigns, almost double what had ever been spent before on an election.
- The move by Gov. Christine Todd Whitman of New Jersey to dismiss the state's prison doctors and hire a private company to deliver managed care has gained favor as well as drawn concern.
- Alberto Fujimori, president of Peru, shows no signs of abandoning his authoritarian ways in the face of the hostage crisis in Lima.

- Members of Rwanda's Tutsi minority say they are terrified Hutu militants will kill them now that militiamen from the Hutu majority who carried out the mass killings of Tutsi in 1994 are drifting back home.
